title: Locksmiths and Safe Repairers
description: Repair and open locks, make keys, change locks and safe combinations, and install and repair safes.

tasks.text: Cut new or duplicate keys, using impressions or code key machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

tasks.text: Insert new or repaired tumblers into locks to change combinations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Move picklocks in cylinders to open door locks without keys.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disabling locks requires hands-on manipulation

tasks.text: Cut new or duplicate keys, using key cutting machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Set up and maintain master key systems.

dwas.name: Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Install door hardware, such as locks and closers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing interior fixtures is hands-on

dwas.name: Install hardware or other interior fixtures.

tasks.text: Keep records of company locks and keys.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

tasks.text: Disassemble mechanical or electrical locking devices, and repair or replace worn tumblers, springs, and other parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of worn mechanical parts

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Repair and adjust safes, vault doors, and vault components, using hand tools, lathes, drill presses, and welding and acetylene cutting apparatus.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Structural repair is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Install alarm and electronic access systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical subsystem assembly requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.

tasks.text: Install safes, vault doors, and deposit boxes according to blueprints, using equipment such as power drills, taps, dies, truck cranes, and dollies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing interior fixtures is hands-on

dwas.name: Install hardware or other interior fixtures.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disabling locks requires hands-on manipulation

tasks.text: Remove interior and exterior finishes on safes and vaults, and spray on new finishes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Refinishing surfaces is skilled manual labor

emerging_tasks.task: Read blueprints and project specification manuals to recommend appropriate hardware and electronic locking devices.
